game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Sand Dunes – Sandstone Arch, a natural sandstone arch: the caravan guide must handle vultures while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Test Gauntlet: Run small test cases against a function and fix the failing ones.
theme: Sand Dunes – Sandstone Arch: a natural sandstone arch
core_gameplay_loop: In Sandstone Arch, repeat each round: Run small test cases against a function and fix the failing ones. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the tests value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the sandstone arch using at most 21 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The sandstone arch reached with actions_used <= 21.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 21 before the sandstone arch is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 6 (applied tier): Test Gauntlet
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Test Gauntlet' (Week 9 slot 5), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Sandstone Arch'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how tests changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against vultures in Sandstone Arch.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The sandstone arch reached with actions_used <= 21.
